intro: Your home feels more welcoming with Fleur Ottoma. A versatile accent for feet, seating, or styling, it combines soft cushioning with warm tones to add comfort and charm to daily living.

features.title: Adaptable design for every moment
features.text: From extra seating for guests to a cozy footrest after work or a handy side table during tea, it flexes effortlessly to your lifestyle.

features.title: Plush cushioning that pampers you
features.text: Foam padding offers gentle bounce and soft support, so resting your legs or sitting down always feels inviting and indulgent.

features.title: Compact and easy to reposition
features.text: Its lightweight form makes rearranging your room simple, helping you create space or seating options without effort.

features.title: Durable fabric made for daily life
features.text: Upholstery stands up to everyday use while keeping its softness intact, ensuring your ottoman feels fresh and reliable for years.

features.title: Camel shade that warms your décor
features.text: The earthy camel tone blends with wood, grey, or cream palettes, adding homely warmth that makes your living space instantly more welcoming.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
